field_text_formatted.value: Drupal is 25 this year, and its code has had linters for a long time. Its words haven't, and with Drupal AI writing straight into the node form, more of them now come from a model. A search of drupal.org turns up readability scores and spellcheckers, but nothing that holds a save to your own style guide.
